summary: PRED-073/FAIL-019 observational caveats rest on a false premise: the cited CHAOS-7 'May 2026 data' can never exist (model deprecated, data ends June 2024; CHAOS-8 covers only through 2025). Correct caveat text in both files.
detail: Verified by direct fetch of DTU Space pages 2026-06-06: (a) CHAOS-7 page carries banner 'CHAOS-7 is now out-dated'; final release CHAOS-7.18 uses Swarm data to 2 June 2024 only. (b) CHAOS-8 (successor) is 'valid from 1999 to 2025', last site update 03-Mar-2026 — no published CHAOS release covers April-May 2026. THEREFORE: FAIL-019.observational_caveat ('May 2026 CHAOS-7 monthly SAA-centroid datapoint not yet published as of 2026-06-05') and PRED-073 notes/detail_reasoning ('CHAOS-7 May data typically available early June') imply an imminent datapoint that is structurally impossible on the cited source. FIX: replace with 'No published CHAOS release covers April-May 2026 (CHAOS-7 deprecated, final data June 2024; CHAOS-8 validity ends 2025, site updated 03-Mar-2026, doi:10.1186/s40623-025-02352-0). Falsified verdict rests on the stable secular-rate null (~0.024 deg/mo vs dome >=0.3 deg/mo, 12x); observational cross-check cannot arrive before a future CHAOS-8 update (realistically late 2026+). If such a release eventually shows >=0.3 deg April->May 2026 westward drift, reassessment required.' BONUS for decider: (1) when d=8 HIGH escalation fires (~2026-06-08), frame it on the dome's acknowledgment gap (no closure note/extension), not on 'failed to post result' — the dome could not post a CHAOS-derived result either; (2) poller watch-list carries 'CHAOS-7 May data due imminently' — same false premise, route a poller-prompt correction via tinker; (3) new structural point available for future prose: prediction was unverifiable-as-registered on its own stated source (registered 2026-04-04 citing an already-superseded model and a non-existent monthly cadence) — rhymes with the OTS wrong-side pattern.
